name: Roast suckling pig
summary: Roast suckling pig at the Pac Ngoi table when the house has booked it with the meal.
origin: Pac Ngoi. VOV on the rural desk. VnExpress, 28 November 2014, names it in the same stay as hill chicken and upland rice.
howToEat: Eat it at the house when the meal has been booked. VOV does not call it a breakfast.
